assessment_name: Fictional organization — NIST CSF 2.0 portfolio demonstration

top_priorities.control_title: Inventories of software services and systems are maintained
top_priorities.remediation: Create a service catalog with owners and lifecycle status

top_priorities.control_title: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring
top_priorities.remediation: Enable organization-wide logging with retention and access controls

top_priorities.control_title: Risk management objectives are established for suppliers and third parties
top_priorities.remediation: Create supplier tiering and security due diligence requirements

top_priorities.control_title: Cybersecurity responsibilities and authorities are established
top_priorities.remediation: Publish a RACI and obtain leadership approval

top_priorities.control_title: Threats vulnerabilities likelihood and impacts are used to understand risk
top_priorities.remediation: Adopt a documented likelihood and impact methodology

top_priorities.control_title: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find anomalies
top_priorities.remediation: Centralize audit logs and define detection use cases

top_priorities.control_title: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents
top_priorities.remediation: Create notification criteria contacts and approval workflow

top_priorities.control_title: The confidentiality integrity and availability of data-in-use are protected
top_priorities.remediation: Document sensitive processing safeguards and approved use cases

top_priorities.control_title: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained
top_priorities.remediation: Reconcile endpoint inventory with procurement and identity sources

top_priorities.control_title: Identities and credentials are issued managed verified revoked and audited
top_priorities.remediation: Centralize joiner mover leaver workflows and access reviews
